title: tune-nccl-overlap-kvcache-continuous-batching-tensor-parallel-collectives
author: Ava Patel
description:
Motivation:
We observed suboptimal overlap between NCCL collectives and device compute in multi-GPU tensor-parallel workloads when KV cache continuous batching is enabled. On 8xA100 internal benchmarks this produced tail latency regressions under mixed request sizes and reduced throughput under sustained load. This PR tunes NCCL stream priorities, scheduling heuristics, and adjusts kernel launch sync points in the runtime to increase overlap and reduce kernel-induced stalls. It also adds lightweight coordination in the KV cache continuous batching path to avoid head-of-line blocking during collective boundaries.

What this change does (high level):
- Introduces a two-tier NCCL stream priority model for tensor-parallel collectives: high-priority for latency-sensitive small collectives, normal-priority for bulk async collectives.
- Adds a scheduling window in serving/runtime/nccl_scheduler.cpp to reorder async collectives when safe to increase overlap with compute kernels.
- Changes kernel launch patterns to avoid implicit device-wide synchronizations (removed a pair of cudaDeviceSynchronize calls and replaced them with event-based synchronization).
- Adds per-stream kernel/collective accounting so the runtime can make batching decisions that avoid contention with KV cache writes.
- KV cache continuous batching: adds a small flush-coalescing heuristic in serving/runtime/kv_cache/kv_cache_manager.cpp that reduces cross-GPU rendezvous during boundary conditions for tiny requests.
- Adds unit and integration tests, and microbench harnesses used for the performance numbers below.

Performance results (internal perf-lab, 8xA100, FP16, mixed request sizes):
- Throughput (tokens/sec) +12% on steady-state generation workloads.
- P99 latency -8% on small (<=64 tokens) requests under 95th percentile load.
- End-to-end cost-per-token estimated reduction ~15% due to higher GPU utilization and reduced blocking.

Testing and validation:
- New unit tests for nccl_scheduler and continuous_batcher behavior added under test/runtime/.
- Integration tests run in CI: multi-gpu-smoke, tp-collectives-stress, kvcache-continous-batching-harness.
- Perf harness runs included in PR comments with reproducible steps.

Rollout plan:
- Feature is guarded behind runtime flag --tp-nccl-overlap-tuning (default enabled for dedicated and internal perf clusters; flagged on and tested in staging before broader rollout).
- Will monitor per-route p99 and GPU utilization dashboards; automatic fallback to previous scheduler on regression.

Checklist:
- [x] Unit tests added
- [x] Integration tests added
- [x] Perf numbers attached
- [x] Docs note (console observability) updated

Related: Linear ENG-4789, ENG-5021. Incident follow-up: INT-2430 (linked in Linear) identified the p99 regressions in earlier KV-cache batching refactor.

review_comments: Jordan Li (reviewer): Looks good overall. Can you add a short explanation for the choice of priority thresholds? Also make sure we don't starve large collectives.

Ava Patel (author): Added comment and a small adaptive backoff that demotes high-priority if it sees >80% occupancy for 500ms. Updated nccl_scheduler.cpp: added explanation and unit test for demotion behavior.
Marcus Chen (reviewer): Please confirm that event-based sync avoids any lingering cuda errors on the stress harness. Requested change: add a stress run to CI or attach regression numbers.
Ava Patel: Added harness runs and attached results to PR description; CI integration test increased timeout to accommodate stress run. Marcus Chen: Approve after CI green.
Priya Nair (approver): Verified perf numbers on dedicated perf cluster; approving.
release_notes: Runtime: Improved multi-GPU tensor-parallel performance by tuning NCCL stream priorities and scheduling to increase overlap between collectives and compute. Reduced p99 latency for small requests and improved throughput in continuous KV cache batching scenarios. Rollout is feature-flagged and monitored.
notes_for_oncall: If you see p99 regressions after rollout: disable --tp-nccl-overlap-tuning on the cluster, collect per-GPU stream utilization and NCCL tracing logs (enable NCCL logging), and tag ENG-4789 in the incident. Fallback policy will revert to previous scheduler automatically if enabled in route config.
perf_harness_instructions: Run perf/harnesses/tp_overlap_harness.py with --gpus 8 --model small-gpt --precision fp16 --duration 600 --workload mixed; compare baseline commit a1b2c3d. Repro steps and raw numbers are attached to PR comments.
